title: Due-Day Change Terms for Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts
content:
A borrower on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts may move the day of the month installments fall due, on these terms.

## Conditions

- A due-date change is made only on a contract whose status is active.
- The change is made only while no installment is past due, that is on or before the next due date. The current day is compared with the next due date as calendar dates; a request on the next due date itself qualifies. No grace days are added to this comparison: the allowance is 0 days after the next due date shown on the contract record.
- At least the tier's due-date change minimum installments must have been paid, counting the contract's scheduled-installment payments that no returned payment points at, and the due-date changes used must be below the tier's lifetime maximum.
- The new due day must be later in the month than the current one by no more than the tier's maximum shift days, and must be between 1 and 28. A move to an earlier day is not offered.
- A deferral and a due-date change are not granted in the same calendar month.

## Effect

The next due date and the maturity date move to the new day in their own months.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, next due date 2026-09-12, maximum shift 15 days)

| Request date | New due day requested | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-12 | 20th | allowed on timing (the next due date itself) and on shift (8 days later) |
| 2026-09-13 | 20th | not allowed: the installment is past due |
| 2026-09-05 | 27th | allowed on shift: 15 days later |
| 2026-09-05 | 28th | not allowed: 16 days later |
| 2026-09-05 | 5th | not offered: an earlier day |

With the change to the 20th, a next due date of 2026-09-12 becomes 2026-09-20 and a maturity date of 2029-02-12 becomes 2029-02-20.
